comment: Temporary exceptions for npm audit findings that have no released fix and are not exploitable in the portal's build-time/static-site usage. Each entry must include a removal trigger.

exceptions.title: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs
exceptions.removalTrigger: Upgrade @docusaurus/* to a release that no longer depends on a vulnerable picomatch range, or wait for a patched picomatch release and refresh package-lock.json.
exceptions.reason: The portal is a static Docusaurus docs site; picomatch is used only at build time with trusted, repository-controlled glob patterns. There is no user-supplied glob input and no runtime ReDoS attack surface.
